_note: Goldilocks commits for the efficacy severe test. Each: surgical-revert makes oracle RED; task is non-leaking (touches the buggy region without naming the bug); lesson is the real one the system stored. UPPER-BOUND test — see efficacy-harness.mjs header. bac2e85 is the airtight construction (rewrite-delete-loop naturally raises recover-before-delete); 3f26b7a + aacab0c are exploratory (missing-WHERE bugs where a neutral query edit may or may not pull the agent into the omitted filter).

commits.task: In lib/maintain-core.mjs, the functions cleanupBroken and purgeStale each delete at most opCap rows in one SQL statement (LIMIT opCap). Change BOTH so they delete ALL matching rows, looping in batches of opCap until no rows match. Each function must still return the total number of rows deleted, and you must not change their signatures or which rows count as deletable.
commits.lessonTitle: purgeStale/cleanupBroken orphaned a deleted keeper's children (compressed_into no FK)
commits.lesson: When hard-DELETEing rows referenced by a no-FK soft-delete pointer (compressed_into), recover the referencing rows FIRST (null the pointer to un-hide) — enumerate ALL hard-delete paths (purgeStale AND cleanupBroken), not just the obvious one.
commits.lessonBody: compressed_into has no FK; hard-deleting a merge-target orphans its children, hidden from every COALESCE(compressed_into,0)=0 view. Fix: recoverChildrenOf sets compressed_into=NULL on children, THEN delete.

commits.task: In mem-cli.mjs cmdSearch, the vector/RRF retrieval branch hydrates each candidate result with a `SELECT ... FROM observations WHERE id = ?`. One of the two hydration SELECTs omits the `project` column while the other includes it. Make the two hydration SELECTs consistent so every vector/RRF result object carries the same fields, including `project`.
commits.lessonTitle: search --type filter bypass via vector RRF path (CLI parity gap)
commits.lesson: When two retrieval paths feed one result set, every WHERE clause on path A must have a paired filter on path B — both at call site (pass arg) and at merge/hydration site (post-filter). Audit: diff each vectorSearch() option object against the FTS WHERE clause.
commits.lessonBody: CLI mem-cli.mjs vector/RRF path missed the type+project filters the FTS path applied, so --type/--project leaked non-matching rows. Pair every FTS WHERE clause with a vector-path filter at both call and merge sites.

commits.task: In mem-cli.mjs cmdCitationStats, the query that builds the 'promoted' list selects the top cited observations ordered by cited_count descending. Add importance as a secondary sort key so that among rows with equal cited_count, higher-importance rows come first. Keep the LIMIT.
commits.lessonTitle: multi-lifecycle-flag queries must enumerate every state (compressed_into AND superseded_at)
commits.lesson: When a schema has multiple lifecycle flags (compressed_into, superseded_at), partition/filter queries must enumerate every state — checking only COALESCE(compressed_into,0)=0 misses superseded-not-compressed rows. Exclude superseded_at rows from any 'live/promoted' list.
commits.lessonBody: A 'promoted'/'live' list that filters only on compressed_into still surfaces superseded rows (superseded_at IS NOT NULL). Add AND superseded_at IS NULL alongside the compressed_into gate.
